---
title: "Trends"
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
attacks <- read_rds("data/attacks.rds")
```

```{r}
attacks |>
  filter(Fatal_clean != "Unknown") |>
  add_count(Activity, name = "activity_total") |>
  filter(activity_total >= 50) |>
  count(Activity, Fatal_clean) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = Activity, y = n, fill = Fatal_clean)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    x = "Activity",
    y = "Number of attacks",
    fill = "Outcome"
  )
```
